content.content:
We need Italian and French. The list shows Italian entries: Cafe Coffee Day (Italian), Connoisseur (Italian), Mr. Brown (Italian), Wrapster (Italian), maybe others. French entries: Dhaba Ambarsariya (French), MR.D (French), Wrapster (French). We can pick a few.

Now plan each day.

Day 1: March 26, travel from Charlotte to Hilton Head. Drive ~4 hrs. Check departure early morning. Breakfast in Charlotte (maybe at a local spot). For simplicity, we can set breakfast in Charlotte at "The Original Pancake House". Lunch upon arrival in Hilton Head at Italian restaurant "Connoisseur". Attractions: after lunch, visit Harbour Town Lighthouse and Coligny Beach Park. Dinner at French restaurant "Wrapster". Accommodation: The Westin Hilton Head Island Resort & Spa (two rooms). Transportation: drive.

Day 2: March 27, full day Hilton Head. Breakfast at hotel or Italian cafe "Cafe Coffee Day". Attractions: Coastal Discovery Museum; Sea Pines Forest Preserve; Driessen Beach Park. Lunch at Italian "Mr. Brown". Dinner at French "MR.D". Accommodation same.

Day 3: March 28, last day. Breakfast at hotel. Morning attraction: Historic Mitchelville Freedom Park. Lunch at Italian "Connoisseur". Afternoon drive back to Charlotte. Dinner back in Charlotte maybe at Italian "Maggiano's"? Not needed? But include dinner maybe on the road. Could just have dinner at "The Original Pancake House" again. Transportation: drive back.

Now need to ensure budget $7k. Estimate: accommodation $300 per night per room *2 rooms = $600 per night, 3 nights = $1800. Car rental? Assume own car fuel cost $19 (from distance). Meals: average $30 per person per meal *5 people *3 days *3 meals = $1350. Attractions maybe minimal cost. Total ~ $3200 well under $7k.

Now call submit_day_plan for each day. Need fields: day, current_city (maybe "Charlotte" day1 start, "Hilton Head" day2, "Hilton Head" day3), transportation (string), breakfast, attraction (semicolon separated), lunch, dinner, accommodation.
